points.description: States that firm yield is the maximum (greatest) amount of water/supply that can be obtained or supplied (the maximum reliable/safe yield).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'amount of supply/yield' without maximum, or vaguely 'reliable supply'.

points.description: States that this supply is guaranteed (available without failure) during the critical dry period (e.g. worst drought / lowest flow period).
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions only a dry period/drought without guarantee, or only guaranteed without the critical dry period.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for a definition saying firm yield is the maximum supply that can be guaranteed during the critical dry period (drought), in any wording. Give 1 mark where only one of the two ideas is present or they are stated vaguely. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong definitions, e.g. average yield or flood flow.
